errors.stepNotAboveUsed: Enter more than the {{used}} tokens {{step}} already used.
errors.stepAboveMax: A step budget can be at most {{max}} tokens, the maximum run budget (project setting).

errors.serverOnly: This change is made on the server for a shared project, and this screen cannot send it there yet.
errors.notShared: This project's task list is not shared.
errors.alreadyShared: This project's task list is shared already.
errors.offline: {{server}} can't be reached, so nothing was sent. The list is read-only until it answers.
errors.notMember: You are no longer a member of this project on the server, so nothing was sent.
errors.serverMissing: The server this project is shared on is no longer in Settings › Servers.
errors.invalidAnswer: The server answered with something Orchester can't use; nothing was changed here.
errors.keptChanging: The task kept changing on the server while Orchester merged your change. Open it again and save once more.
errors.unavailable: The server of this shared project can't be asked now.
errors.notEditable: The server didn't take the change: the task can't be edited in its state.
errors.organization: The server didn't take the status, priority, tags or links: they break a rule of the task list.
errors.remoteTaken: This repository is shared on the server already.
errors.shareInProgress: This project is being shared right now, so nothing was changed. Try again once sharing has finished.

members.noSuchUser: The server has no user with this username. Usernames are exact; an admin of the server creates accounts.
members.alreadyMember: This person is already a member. Change their role in their row.
members.lastOwner: You are the last owner. Make another member an owner first; then you can become a member or leave.

notShared.readOnly: This task is Not shared, so it is read-only. Share task on its page uploads it first.

refused.held: {{holder}} has taken this task, so nothing started. Ask them, or wait until they release it.
refused.heldStale: {{holder}} has taken this task and their claim has gone stale; nothing started. Take it over from the task page once that is possible.
refused.heldUnknown: Someone else has taken this task, so nothing started.
refused.merged: This task was merged; nobody takes it into work again.
